desc.zh: 从一次空位交换推导广度优先搜索，用完整层证明最少移动次数。
desc.en: Derive breadth-first search from a blank swap and prove minimum moves with complete layers.

complexity: O(V+E) time; O(V) auxiliary space for fixed six-cell states, V ≤ 720 and E ≤ 3V

concepts.name: Breadth-first search layers
concepts.description: Discover each board once and prove shortest move counts by complete layers.

concepts.name: State graph
concepts.description: Encode complete boards and connect them with legal blank swaps.
